measurement_boundary: Loading pretrained ResNet18 weights, image decoding, prescribed preprocessing, frozen ResNet18 inference and cache writing for all three splits; excludes dataset download. CodeCarbon machine mode measures the whole computer, so the idle desktop, display output and any other open programs (e.g. TensorBoard, browser) are included; see the idle-baseline run for this fixed background draw.
reuse_notes: Creates the image-feature caches; reuses pretrained ImageNet weights only. All 8,079 Part B (humanitarian) images are a subset of these 12,708 images, so Part B can reuse this cache by image_id instead of re-extracting.
notes: One extraction pass per split; no training, loss, LR schedule or F1. Seed is null because extraction is deterministic inference. Feature vectors preserve TSV row order.
